title: Test LLM bounds-only edits against matched random bounds
hypothesis: LLM-chosen parameter bounds constrain imitation updates to successful control regimes while preserving the parent's executable structure and initialization.

prediction.against: Matched random-bound edits with identical fitting and rollout selection
prediction.rationale: Five points over a width-matched random control would identify useful LLM guidance rather than generic regularization. This changes parameter metadata only, unlike the structural mutations and evidence-enriched repairs already decided. Remote and LLM spend require per-idea approval.

protocol.command: python scripts/stage_f.py bounds-only --parents simple_damped_push simple_reach_push_shared_gain --fit-seeds 2823 2824 --probe-seed 2820 --heldout-seed 2822 --range-seed 2825 --out-dir logs/research/bounds_only_s2820
code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py (bounds-only: per cell an unedited fit, one gpt-6.1-sol call narrowing <= 2 ranges from the unedited probe trajectory, a width-matched random control, all three fitted identically and scored on 50 confirmation cases; step-0 probes cached by parameters)

falsified_by: An upper paired 95% confidence bound below +0.05 against random bounds refutes the prediction. No positive gain over the identically fitted unedited parent refutes the survive-refit claim; zero-spanning intervals are inconclusive.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00017, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation

controls.note: control is the width- and parameter-matched random-bound arm in the same cell; the metric is already LLM minus random

result.notes: Four cells (simple_damped_push, simple_reach_push_shared_gain x fit seeds 2823/2824), probe s2820, confirmation s2822, random placement seed 2825. The LLM declined to narrow anything for simple_damped_push (both cells: an empty, valid edit list, so all three arms are the unedited fit); for shared_gain it raised the lower bound of contact_radius (to 0.05 and 0.03). LLM minus random +0.000 [+0.000, +0.000] (0/0/50): the random width-matched bounds produced identical confirmation outcomes. LLM minus unedited +0.010 [-0.004, +0.024], equal to random minus unedited; the only movement is one shared_gain cell (0.64 to 0.68 for both edited arms). Narrowed bounds barely bind: the unedited fit does not wander into the excluded region, so restricting it changes little. Step-0 probes were shared by parameter hash across arms and a parent's two cells: 780 episodes (180 probe + 600 confirmation), under the 880 estimate; 4 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: LLM-chosen bounds minus width-matched random bounds is +0.000 [+0.000, +0.000], 0/0/50; the upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, which refutes. Neither edited arm beats the unedited parent with a positive lower bound (+0.010 [-0.004, +0.024] for both). The LLM made no edit for damped push and a single contact_radius floor for shared_gain; matched random floors did exactly as well, so there is no evidence of informed placement. The bounds rarely bind during rollout-selected fitting.
verdicts.next_experiment: Stop testing LLM interventions on the fitted seed bank (structural, repair, scope and bounds all null or negative); the one positive is a single structure. Next: decide bank admission for gen0_cand5_a0 (user ruling), or spend on the search pipeline itself (e.g. a fresh two-lane generation seeded with gen0_cand5_a0).

verdicts.reasoning: The named matched-random control was measured: paired_success_difference was 0.000, with a paired 95% interval of [0.000, 0.000] [logs/research/bounds_only_s2820/summary.json]. Its upper bound is below the predicted +0.05 threshold, meeting the predeclared refutation condition; tied success is not an improvement [logs/research/bounds_only_s2820/summary.json]. The comparison against unedited fitting remains inconclusive: +0.010 with an interval of [-0.004, +0.024] does not establish a benefit [logs/research/bounds_only_s2820/summary.json]. The LLM left the damped-push bounds unchanged, and its shared-gain edits tied their random controls, so this result refutes the tested procedure's prediction without establishing that all possible bounds edits are ineffective [logs/research/bounds_only_s2820/cells.json].
